documents.text: An empty set is a set with no elements. The empty set is unique. A finite state machine has a start state. The state machine transitions on input. A base class defines behaviour; a derived class extends the base class. Each required field is validated; a required field with no value fails. The set of states of the state machine forms a state space.

The empty set contains nothing. A state machine has states. The base class is abstract; the base class defines the interface. A required field must be present; the required field is checked. The state machine reads the set and updates the state.
Set theory studies the empty set and every set. The state machine and its state set. The base class and each required field. A required field maps to a state in the state machine.
